target.statement: Fitted multi-instrument precision-weighted Deming model parameters (σ, κ, and per-instrument α, β, λ with jackknife SEs) for the simulated 4-instrument example (n=120, μ geometric 8-80, σ=3, κ=0.08, α=(-1,1,2,-2), β=(1.1,0.9,1.2,0.8), λ=(1.8,0.45,0.9,0.9))
target.table_ref: Page 10 parameter table (σ=1.8117, κ=0.0790; α/β/λ with se)
target.dataset: Simulated data described in the paper (no external data needed)

compute.basis: The target is a single fit on n=120 x 4 instruments; the paper states each sample fit took 0.1 s, so runtime is trivial and the effort is installing the ppwdeming R package and reconstructing the simulation seed/setup to match the reported numbers.

blockers: No explicit code/config for the exact simulation seed or the example script is given; must reconstruct the data generation from the text
The real-world example (8 instruments, 83 samples) uses data from reference (3) that is not linked, so only the simulated example is reproducible
title: Multiple Instrument Methods Comparison by Precision weighted Deming Regression
